about.label: About
about.title: About Me
about.text: Senior IT consultant with 25 years of experience in data architecture and business intelligence. I work on enterprise data platforms and lately I've turned my technical curiosity toward applied AI: local systems, multi-agent architectures with persistent memory, automations that orchestrate models and data without relying on third-party cloud infrastructure. Supported languages: English, Italian, Spanish, French, Catalan and Dutch.

nt.chat: The gateway forwards to 127.0.0.1:{port}/ask of the respective agent.
nt.chatAudio: Only Story Whisper (8088) and Night Story (8666) have audio input.
nt.barAsk: Proxy to Bar AI on port 8081.
nt.barAdmin: Proxy to admin_api on port 8083 (used by Test6).
nt.adminChat: If the email is in ADMIN_USER_CHAT_IDS, the Telegram chat_id is resolved server-side.
nt.arenaStart: Abuse caps: max 50 turns, 600 messages, 3 active runs.
nt.imgJobs: Allowed sizes 512/768/1024. Seed ≤ 2^31-1. One job per email.
nt.img2img: Polling identical to txt2img. Requires direct_img2img on Gradio 7860.
nt.ocr: Ollama VISION_OCR_MODEL (default qwen2.5vl), 1-request lock. The "Jai Ca sheet" prefix signals that the JCS agent fired.
nt.gitExec: Requires GIT_ADMIN_ALLOW_WRITE=1 (and GIT_ADMIN_ALLOW_FORCE=1 for forced pull).
nt.dbStatus: Postgres readonly=True session: the DB rejects every write. Leles = all public tables, Emergence = emergence_* tables.
nt.dbTable: Table name validated against information_schema (public schema only): no free queries. Optional filters: user = text on the user column; users = list of values to include (USERS panel checkboxes); date_from / date_to = date range.
nt.dbUsers: Feeds the QueryDb USERS panel (grouped by category with on/off). If the table has no valid user column, the panel does not appear.
